statement: Made-to-Measure (MTM) is a local adjustment of an existing master pattern, while AI Bespoke is a geometric compilation from scratch.
evidence: Executive Summary: 'MTM is a local adjustment of an existing master pattern—a modification operation. AI Bespoke is a geometric compilation from scratch—a generation operation.'

statement: MTM assumes bilateral symmetry and fails or requires manual intervention when a client has uneven shoulders or scoliosis.
evidence: Where The Assumption Breaks, Asymmetry Handling: 'MTM assumes bilateral symmetry. When a client has uneven shoulders or scoliosis, MTM either fails or requires manual intervention.'

statement: AI Bespoke output is deterministic: same input, same output, every time, anywhere.
evidence: Where The Assumption Breaks, Replicability: 'AI Bespoke's output is deterministic—same input, same output, every time, anywhere.'

statement: AETERNAL's AI Bespoke uses Zero-Baseline Calculation, storing no pre-existing templates and computing every garment from biometric data as an independent set of geometric equations.
evidence: The AETERNAL Perspective, Zero-Baseline Calculation: 'The system stores no pre-existing templates. Every garment is calculated from the client's biometric data as an independent set of geometric equations.'

statement: The Deterministic Conflict Matrix automatically executes priority equations to perform geometric compensation for conflicting geometric requirements, requiring no subjective human compromise.
evidence: The AETERNAL Perspective, Deterministic Conflict Matrix: 'When the human body presents conflicting geometric requirements... the system automatically executes priority equations to perform geometric compensation. No subjective human compromise is required.'

statement: The SAR Index (Structural Authority Ratio) is a mandatory mathematical constant (SAR ≥ 1.618) that enforces structural authority; any parameter set below this threshold is programmatically rejected.
evidence: The AETERNAL Perspective, SAR Index: 'A mandatory mathematical constant (SAR ≥ 1.618) that enforces structural authority. Any parameter set below this threshold is programmatically rejected by the engine's compilation pipeline.'

statement: MTM uses linear algebra on isolated measurements, assuming the human body scales proportionally—an assumption that is mathematically false for most individuals.
evidence: Engineering Explanation, Technical Deep Level: 'MTM uses linear algebra on isolated measurements... This assumes the human body scales proportionally—an assumption that is mathematically false for most individuals.'

statement: AI Bespoke uses non-linear computation on whole-body coupled vectors, treating biometric data as a system of coupled equations where each measurement affects every other measurement.
evidence: Engineering Explanation, Technical Deep Level: 'AI Bespoke uses non-linear computation on whole-body coupled vectors. The system treats the client's biometric data as a system of coupled equations where each measurement affects every other measurement.'

statement: A failure mode of MTM is 'Collar Gap,' caused by fixed grading angles of the master pattern mismatching the client's cervical geometry.
evidence: Failure Analysis, If Industry Continues Using MTM: 'Collar Gap: Fixed grading angles of master pattern mismatch client's cervical geometry. Back collar gapes when turning or looking down.'

statement: A failure mode of traditional bespoke is non-replicability, as it relies on individual tailor's intuition, leading to different garments for the same client and measurements.
evidence: Failure Analysis, If Industry Continues Using Traditional Bespoke: 'Non-replicability: Relies on individual tailor's intuition. Same client, same measurements, different tailors produce different garments.'
